fieldValues.title: Who curates subjects, and when?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the subject results (Research: Protocol evolution, part 3). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. The process proposes; the secretary accepts, merges or renames before topics are linked (a gate).
- B. Subjects are fixed by the group in advance; the process may only link.
- C. The process creates freely; a periodic tidy merges them.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How many subjects a real group settles on; whether merging two subjects is a relation, a successor, or a move of links.
fieldValues.next_action: Ask the group for its own list of standing matters and run the two meetings again against it.
